catalogue_metadata.scope_notes: Extraction of structural, domain, and behavioral software architecture patterns excluding agentic loops and prompt engineering.
analysis_limits: Source tree inspection limited to repository manifests, directory layout, and key file symbol exports.

system_map.overview: cas_runner is a continuous architecture governance engine structured into layered domain models, execution engines, and a file-backed knowledge repository.

layers.name: presentation
layers.purpose: CLI entrypoints and workspace initialization commands.

layers.name: application
layers.purpose: Orchestrates governance evaluations, flow runs, and action dispatching.

layers.name: domain
layers.purpose: Typed data schemas for capabilities, governance inventories, compliance metrics, and health states.

layers.name: infrastructure
layers.purpose: Pluggable provider clients, telemetry instrumentation, and file-based repository storage.

components.name: GovernanceActionEngine
components.responsibility: Executes state transitions and resolves governance mutations through a transition registry.

components.name: ComplianceEngine
components.responsibility: Evaluates architectural rules and outputs compliance findings.

components.name: FlowRunner
components.responsibility: Manages execution sequence across steering and governance pipelines.

components.name: HealthModel
components.responsibility: Calculates composite health statuses from governance metrics and risk factors.

orchestration.execution_style: Imperative pipeline triggered via CLI flows and GitHub Actions workflows.
orchestration.boundary: FlowRunner encapsulates sequence flow between local file evaluation and engine processing.

tools_and_integrations.name: Pydantic
tools_and_integrations.role: Strict type validation and schema serialization

state_and_memory.name: File-based Knowledge Store
state_and_memory.description: Structured repository containing global policies, project rules, templates, and runtime trace states.

patterns.name: Pydantic Domain Entity and Value Object Modeling
patterns.summary: Core governance and steering concepts are encapsulated using immutable and validated Pydantic data structures.
patterns.intent: Ensure strong typing, schema validation, and safe data exchange across engine boundaries without coupled runtime behaviors.
patterns.context: Governance audits and architectural delta evaluations process disparate data formats from git histories and repository files.
forces: Need for serializable models that integrate cleanly with JSON and YAML.
Requirement to catch malformed governance records early at the boundary.
Desire to keep domain entities free of execution side-effects.
patterns.solution: Define data structures such as GovernanceInventory, ComplianceFinding, CapabilityRecord, and ArchitecturalDelta as typed models with built-in validation.
implementation_signals: Type annotations across field declarations with explicit Enums for status types.

evidence.note: Defines domain structures for tracking governance inventory, compliance findings, and health states.
Models capability tracking and architectural change diffs with typed attributes.

benefits: Automatic runtime serialization and validation against schemas.
Clear boundary contracts between domain logic and persistence.
costs: Slight performance overhead during high-volume object instantiation.
failure_modes: Validation errors raised during runtime if data sources deviate from defined schema constraints.

patterns.reuse_notes: Adopt Pydantic models for all entities crossing process or file boundaries.

patterns.name: Transition Registry State Machine
patterns.summary: Registry-based lookup that maps permissible transitions and action handlers for governance entities.
patterns.intent: Decouple lifecycle state transitions from the execution engine driving governance actions.
patterns.context: Governance artifacts progress through discrete states requiring distinct validation rules and side effects.
forces: Multiple governance actions can mutate entity status.
Ad-hoc if/else checks across state changes lead to spaghetti code and unvalidated transitions.
patterns.solution: Centralize transition rules into a dedicated TransitionRegistry consumed by GovernanceActionEngine.
implementation_signals: Explicit TransitionRegistry symbol used by engine services.
Separation of state validation from state execution logic.

evidence.note: TransitionRegistry provides deterministic transition management for governance actions.

benefits: Simplifies adding new lifecycle transitions without modifying core engine logic.
Ensures invalid state transitions are rejected deterministically.
costs: Additional indirection when tracing action dispatching.
failure_modes: Missing transitions in the registry can lead to unhandled action errors.

patterns.reuse_notes: Useful whenever domain entities have formal lifecycle states with specific validation gates.

patterns.name: Service Layer Application Facade
patterns.summary: Orchestrates complex multi-engine operations behind high-level application service interfaces.
patterns.intent: Provide a clean boundary between external callers (CLI, automated workflows) and underlying compliance/governance engines.
patterns.context: A single governance invocation requires inspecting inventories, verifying compliance, and executing actions.
forces: Clients should not need to instantiate and coordinate multiple internal engines.
Workflow scripts and CLI handlers must remain lightweight.
patterns.solution: Expose coarse-grained services like GovernanceActionService and FlowRunner that encapsulate engine coordination.
implementation_signals: Service classes acting as coordinators between storage/repositories and evaluation engines.
CLI handlers delegating immediately to runner or service methods.

evidence.note: Coordinates governance action resolution and execution logic.
Main execution coordinator wrapping flow execution.
Entry point dispatching user commands directly into service facades.

benefits: Enables independent testing of engines and CLI commands.
costs: Risk of creating anemic services that merely forward calls if logic is improperly balanced.
failure_modes: Leaking engine-specific exceptions through the facade.

patterns.reuse_notes: Standard pattern for command-line and workflow-driven orchestration backends.

patterns.name: Swappable Provider Adapter
patterns.summary: Isolates external client interfaces behind interchangeable client implementations, enabling mock substitution for tests and offline runs.
patterns.intent: Decouple application services from concrete external API clients to facilitate offline development and unit testing.
patterns.context: External integrations (like LiteLLM) incur costs, latency, and require API keys that may not be present in CI environments.
forces: Automated CI testing requires deterministic responses without network calls.
Production runtime requires real remote API invocation.
patterns.solution: Provide parallel client implementations (MockLLMClient alongside LiteLLMClient) conforming to the same invocation signature.
implementation_signals: Presence of Mock and Live client classes in an integration module.

evidence.note: Deterministic mock provider implementation for offline or test scenarios.

benefits: Enables offline end-to-end testing and eliminates network flakiness in CI.
Localizes dependency on external integration libraries.
costs: Mock client behavior must be kept in sync with upstream changes in the real client.
failure_modes: Behavioral drift between mock responses and real provider responses.

patterns.reuse_notes: Implement an explicit abstract base class or protocol when expanding client implementations.

patterns.name: File-Backed Knowledge Repository
patterns.summary: Persistent architectural and governance state is structured in version-controlled markdown, YAML, and JSON directories.
patterns.intent: Use git as the source of truth for architecture decisions, patterns, governance rules, and runtime profiles.
patterns.context: Architecture artifacts need transparency, branchability, peer-review capabilities, and audit histories without database lock-in.
forces: Decisions and patterns must be visible and editable by developers directly in source control.
Runtime tools must be able to read and write execution context without external relational infrastructure.
patterns.solution: Organize repository storage into segregated hierarchical paths under cas-knowledge/ (global/, governance/, projects/, runtime/, templates/).
implementation_signals: Dedicated directory structure holding rules, templates, and execution profiles.
Bootstrap utilities to initialize and merge repository governance templates.

evidence.note: Initializes and updates local workspace structures against knowledge templates.
Repository root for global rules, project configurations, and runtime state.

benefits: Complete auditability and version history through Git commits.
Zero database setup overhead for local CLI runners.
costs: File contention and potential merge conflicts during concurrent workflow executions.
failure_modes: Partial writes or malformed file changes corrupting knowledge repository parsers.

patterns.reuse_notes: Common in GitOps and Architecture-as-Code implementations.

patterns.name: Functional Health Evaluation
patterns.summary: Composite health calculation is implemented as pure, side-effect-free functions operating on status models.
patterns.intent: Isolate health calculation and explanation logic from I/O or stateful monitoring agents.
patterns.context: Dashboards and CLI tools need to assess system health and provide explanatory reasons from point-in-time metrics.
forces: Health checks must be computable without side effects.
Calculations must be easily verifiable via unit tests with arbitrary mock metrics.
patterns.solution: Provide stateless functions calculate_health and get_health_reasons that take metric structures and return typed HealthStatus enum values.
implementation_signals: Pure functions taking state models and returning enums and strings without I/O.

evidence.note: Pure functions evaluating system and governance metrics into categorized health states.

benefits: Extremely easy to test across edge cases.
Can be evaluated in parallel across projects without shared state hazards.
costs: Caller must collect and pass the complete metric snapshot beforehand.
failure_modes: Missing or unhandled metric combinations yielding default degraded statuses.

patterns.reuse_notes: Ideal for scorecard, evaluation, and dashboard metric engines.

anti_patterns.name: Split State of Truth (Filesystem vs Runtime Memory)
symptoms: Runtime engines retaining in-memory caches that do not reflect Git changes made by parallel processes or bootstrap updates.
Divergence between cas-knowledge/runtime/ files and active SteeringRuntimeIndex objects.
impact: Stale governance validations and conflicting writes to governance rule states.
suggested_remediation: Implement explicit reload hooks or timestamp-based freshness validation before engine evaluation steps.

cross_cutting_concerns.description: OpenTelemetry SDK and API integration across runner operations for trace tracking.

cross_cutting_concerns.name: Schema and Format Validation
cross_cutting_concerns.description: Validation of declarative JSON/YAML structures using Pydantic and jsonschema.

open_questions.topic: Concurrency handling in cas-knowledge file persistence
open_questions.detail: How the system prevents file lock collisions or race conditions during parallel GitHub Actions runs writing to cas-knowledge/runtime.
